annotations.title: Weather by Address (now, and about the next two days)

description: ONE POINT, NOW AND ABOUT THE NEXT TWO DAYS. Weather by Address: point weather for any U.S. coordinate or street address, with current conditions, active severe weather alerts and a short-term rain outlook. Use for what the weather is or will be at a location; add hours_ahead=0-48 for a forecast hour. Not for storm history or storm-risk forecasts (use get_address_report, get_property_storm_history_report, get_storm_history or get_risk_forecast). Without a key, returns the exact price quote ($0.0002) and a pay link; with a key (or x402 payment) it returns the weather data, billed $0.0002 per call (not per address).

address.description: Street address. Server-side geocoding, no separate geocoding step needed.

api_key.description: Advanced, normally leave empty: add your key in the connector's Authorization header instead of typing it in chat. Optional Atlas United API key (tfx_live_...).

details.description: true = full pull ($0.0002/call). Requires an API key or x402 payment; without a key, returns a price quote and pay link.

hours_ahead.description: Forecast 0-48h out instead of current conditions; snaps to the nearest available forecast hour, and forecast_hour_used says what you got.

sandbox.description: true = free real data (up to 10 records) at the sandbox place only: 1100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 (lat 30.2747, lon -97.7404) or Travis County, TX. Elsewhere it has no effect.

x_payment.description: Advanced, for automated crypto payments only; leave empty. Optional signed x402 payment payload, used instead of an API key.
